targets.query: from(bucket:"rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mem" and r._field=="used") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> set(key:"_field", value:"mem_used")

from(bucket:"rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="mem" and r._field=="available") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> set(key:"_field", value:"mem_available")

from(bucket:"rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="swap" and r._field=="used") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> set(key:"_field", value:"swap_used")

from(bucket:"rpi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="docker_container_mem" and r._field=="usage") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> group(columns:["container_name"]) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","container_name"])

from(bucket:"homeassistant") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="W" and r._field=="value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> group(columns:["entity_id"]) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","entity_id"])

panels.title: Temperatures — CPU & disks (°C)
panels.description: From existing sensors: fastpi CPU and NVMe (node-exporter hwmon), every disk's SMART temperature on fastpi and beefy, tower's hottest thermal zone while the burn-in runs (tower_burnin_cpu_celsius). beefy's CPU package and board (PCH) temperature from its idle watcher (shown only while beefy is awake).

panels.title: Temperatures — probes (°C)

targets.query: from(bucket:"homeassistant") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn:(r)=> r._measurement=="°C" and r._field=="value" and r.entity_id =~ /^temp_probes_/) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> group(columns:["entity_id"]) |> keep(columns:["_time","_value","entity_id"])

panels.description: DS18B20 probes on the ESPHome board temp-probes (Home-Assistant/esphome/temp-probes.yaml): tower CPU cooler, VRM, RAM, PSU exhaust, HDD cage, cabinet intake/exhaust. Empty until the board is flashed.
